supports: TOI re-detects and catches the goal-net back segment that T1 misses in the control.

Static order/properties explain the S3 tick4 response under the continuous sweep.

open: A simultaneous-contact manifold or constraint solve may resolve corner/net chatter; needs a separate controlled experiment.
